title: Credential Exchange Request — payload
description: Holder to issuer: an OID4VCI Credential Request carrying the holder's key-binding proof. Replies on the offer thread.

credential_request.description: An OID4VCI Credential Request object, carried verbatim, including the embedded key-binding proof (`openid4vci-proof+jwt`). Its members are defined by OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance and are not re-specified here. snake_case member names are OID4VCI's own.
